name: ai_synthesis_response
description: The standardized JSON object returned by the Edge AI API based on a user's unstructured brain dump.

requires_clarification.description: True if the urgency is impossible to guess and a 1-tap nudge is required.

clarification_nudge.description: Short prompt asking the user for urgency (e.g. 'Is the presentation due today or next week?')

rationale.description: Brief 1-sentence explanation of why this was chosen.

micro_steps.description: Exactly 3 tiny sub-steps that constitute the recommended action to populate the Start Scaffold.

alternative_actions.description: Up to 2 fallback options loaded secretly into the client, revealed only if the user triggers the Mini Decision Board.

schema._note_for_implementers: This schema must remain flat and simple to ensure Llama-3/DeepSeek 8-13B models can reliably output it zero-shot without structural failure.
